Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

Example:
from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)


Produce a compact, complete first reconstruction immediately, leaving time for
visual correction. Aim for about 180 lines and 250 expanded primitive meshes;
these are planning targets, not external resource limits. Include architecture,
all major visible objects, separate materials, and meaningful composite Asset
groups. Prioritize projected silhouettes, perspective, occlusion and large color
regions before ornament. Keep camera and major dimensions in named parameters.

Before coding, record at most six short comments with visually estimated image
anchors. Use normalized coordinates with origin at TOP LEFT, x right and y down.
Include major bounds, floor/wall boundaries, two perspective edge directions,
and a foreground/background overlap. Record uncertain anchors as uncertain.
Use the actual photograph's framing, including cropped objects and empty spaces.
Do not replace irregular visible silhouettes with generic category prototypes.
Model broad visible surfaces as surfaces with thickness, not just outline rods.

Execution reliability:
- Keep all geometry and relationships in SceneAct; do not redefine constructors
  or bypass the backend with another mesh generator.
- realize(scene) clears Blender. Create camera, lights, materials and world after it.
- Initialize the world before accessing nodes:
  sc = bpy.context.scene
  if sc.world is None:
      sc.world = bpy.data.worlds.new('Ambient')
  sc.world.use_nodes = True
- fillet_box needs 0 < radius <= half the smallest size component, including
  thickness. It expands to up to 23 meshes. Use boxes for thin flat panels.
- Each include key must be unique within its parent, including nested loop keys.
  Duplicate keys replace children. rod endpoints must differ.
- sweep_tube produces rods and spheres; use sparse control points. Avoid dense
  decorative geometry and costly Boolean assemblies. Use simple procedural
  materials for surface patterns; never use the photograph as a texture.
- Keep supports, frames and upholstery together under editable object groups.
- Do not render or save files yourself. Do not change the fixed rendering engine,
  samples, resolution, denoising, backend or resource limits. Configure scene
  lighting, materials and camera only within the permitted API.

Visual correction:
Compare reference and render explicitly before changing code. Distinguish a shared
projection error from individual shape errors. Check edge slopes, visible top/side
surface ratios and near/far size ratios as well as bounding boxes. Focal length
changes framing; camera distance changes perspective too. Do not compensate for
a wrong camera by independently stretching many unrelated objects. Conversely,
do not move a good camera to fix one misplaced object. Use modest changes when
uncertain. Preserve correctly matched geometry, groups and materials.
For brightness, distinguish a global exposure/illumination mismatch from a local
material mismatch. Avoid simultaneously darkening all materials and all lights.
Spend correction renders on the largest visible discrepancies, not tiny details.

A failed execution or missing image provides no new visual evidence. Repair the
reported error and audit the requirements above. After a timeout, substantially
simplify repeated geometry. Missing output is failure, not a quality measurement.
Never claim numerical similarity scores that were not supplied.

Normally return exactly one complete Python code block. A specifically requested
visual audit instead requires concise observations and no code. After a successful
build you may reply DONE to retain the latest successful build, or SELECT <step>
to retain another supplied successful step. Only supplied successful steps count.
All work must use this conversation and the supplied interfaces: no external tools,

```python
# Anchors: window occupies x=0-.30, y=0-.80; cabinet spans x=.29-1, y=0-.53.
# Paper roll bounds approximately (.61,.08)-(.83,.42); ring center approximately (.36,.42).
# Counter/wall boundary runs from approximately (0,.81) through (.48,.66) to (1,.71).
# Perspective edges: counter depth slopes down-left; cabinet bottom slopes down-right then up-right.
# Foreground jug overlaps blender; towel overlaps window and counter accessories.
# Sink is cropped at bottom-left; cabinet top and right side extend beyond frame.
from sceneact import *
import bpy
import math

scene = Scene(name="Window-side kitchen")
CREAM = (.77,.72,.59)
DOOR = (.81,.76,.64)
WHITE = (.88,.85,.75)
CHROME = (.48,.48,.40)
GRANITE = (.29,.265,.205)
NAVY = (.025,.045,.095)

def add(parent, name, node):
    parent.include(name, node)

architecture = Asset("Architecture")
add(architecture,"back_wall",box((3.5,.08,3.1),center=(0,.71,1.4),color=(.71,.67,.54)))
add(architecture,"right_wall",box((.08,2.4,3.1),center=(1.15,-.4,1.4),color=(.73,.68,.55)))
scene.include("architecture",architecture)

window = Asset("Window and Venetian blind")
add(window,"daylight_glass",box((1.25,.025,1.91),center=(-.92,.647,1.72),color=(.72,.86,.89)))
for i,x in enumerate((-1.56,-.29)):
    add(window,"vertical_trim_%d"%i,box((.055,.09,2.08),center=(x,.59,1.73),color=WHITE))
for i,z in enumerate((.70,2.74)):
    add(window,"horizontal_trim_%d"%i,box((1.32,.10,.06),center=(-.925,.58,z),color=WHITE))
add(window,"window_mullion",box((.035,.055,1.94),center=(-1.0,.58,1.72),color=(.86,.87,.79)))
add(window,"window_crossbar",box((1.2,.06,.045),center=(-.93,.57,1.7),color=WHITE))
for i in range(32):
    z=.77+i*.061
    slat=box((1.27,.105,.014),center=(-.925,.49,z),color=(.82,.83,.75))
    slat.turn('x',-13)
    add(window,"blind_slat_%02d"%i,slat)
for i,x in enumerate((-1.36,-.62)):
    add(window,"blind_ladder_%d"%i,box((.011,.008,1.98),center=(x,.425,1.73),color=(.74,.74,.65)))
add(window,"sill",box((1.36,.22,.065),center=(-.94,.54,.725),color=WHITE))
scene.include("window",window)

cabinet=Asset("Cream wall cabinet")
add(cabinet,"carcass",box((1.18,.49,1.65),center=(.34,.40,2.115),color=CREAM))
# The left return is a broad exposed cabinet side.
add(cabinet,"left_return",box((.035,.51,1.67),center=(-.265,.395,2.12),color=(.80,.76,.65)))
add(cabinet,"bottom",box((1.2,.53,.045),center=(.335,.375,1.285),color=DOOR))
for j,(x,w) in enumerate(((.105,.66),(.70,.49))):
    add(cabinet,"door_%d"%j,box((w,.043,1.60),center=(x,.125,2.13),color=DOOR))
    for k,xx in enumerate((x-w/2+.043,x+w/2-.043)):
        add(cabinet,"stile_%d_%d"%(j,k),box((.046,.022,1.53),center=(xx,.094,2.13),color=(.84,.79,.66)))
    for k,zz in enumerate((1.395,2.865)):
        add(cabinet,"rail_%d_%d"%(j,k),box((w-.065,.022,.047),center=(x,.093,zz),color=(.84,.79,.66)))
    add(cabinet,"recess_%d"%j,box((w-.13,.012,1.38),center=(x,.102,2.13),color=(.785,.737,.61)))
add(cabinet,"small_knob",ball(.022,center=(.46,.052,1.59),color=(.37,.32,.19)))
add(cabinet,"knob_stem",rod(.012,start=(.46,.08,1.59),end=(.46,.04,1.59),color=CHROME))
scene.include("cabinet",cabinet)

roll=Asset("Paper towel and wall holder")
add(roll,"paper",rod(.143,start=(.18,-.045,1.58),end=(.18,-.045,2.24),color=(.91,.87,.74)))
add(roll,"paper_top",rod(.134,length=.006,center=(.18,-.045,2.244),color=(.84,.80,.68)))
add(roll,"top_finial",rod(.021,length=.075,center=(.18,-.045,2.287),color=CHROME))
add(roll,"finial_cap",ball(.025,center=(.18,-.045,2.323),color=CHROME))
for i,x in enumerate((.08,.28)):
    add(roll,"lower_support_%d"%i,rod(.017,start=(x,.11,1.56),end=(x,-.065,1.56),color=(.26,.25,.20)))
add(roll,"loose_sheet",box((.22,.006,.35),center=(.183,-.186,1.77),color=(.93,.89,.77)))
scene.include("paper_towels",roll)

towel=Asset("Ring and hanging hand towel")
add(towel,"mount_rosette",rod(.045,start=(-.283,.34,1.82),end=(-.32,.34,1.82),color=CHROME))
add(towel,"mount_neck",rod(.016,start=(-.32,.34,1.82),end=(-.385,.34,1.82),color=CHROME))
points=[]
for i in range(25):
    a=2*math.pi*i/24
    points.append((-.385,.34+.105*math.sin(a),1.665+.145*math.cos(a)))
add(towel,"oval_ring",sweep_tube(points=points,radius=.008,color=(.58,.58,.50)))
# Narrow cloth ribbons form a softly irregular, broad draped surface.
for i in range(11):
    v=(i-5)/5
    yy=.30+v*.083
    bottom=1.00+.048*math.cos(i*.75)+.045*abs(v)
    top=1.55+.035*math.cos(v*1.4)
    xx=-.402-.018*math.sin(i*1.6)
    add(towel,"hanging_fold_%d"%i,box((.024,.020,top-bottom),center=(xx,yy,(top+bottom)/2),color=(.84+.025*math.sin(i),.80+.025*math.sin(i),.69+.02*math.sin(i))))
add(towel,"folded_over_ring",rod(.033,start=(-.413,.21,1.54),end=(-.413,.39,1.54),color=(.89,.85,.74)))
scene.include("hand_towel",towel)

counter=Asset("Granite counter and sink")
slab=box((2.65,1.20,.065),center=(-.15,.03,.815),color=GRANITE)
hole=box((.78,.64,.20),center=(-.83,-.30,.815))
add(counter,"stone_slab",subtract(slab,hole))
add(counter,"cabinet_base",box((2.60,1.12,.75),center=(-.15,.07,.405),color=(.30,.255,.18)))
add(counter,"backsplash",box((2.65,.055,.15),center=(-.15,.615,.90),color=GRANITE))
add(counter,"sink_bottom",box((.75,.61,.025),center=(-.83,-.30,.645),color=(.055,.065,.060)))
for i,x in enumerate((-1.215,-.445)):
    add(counter,"sink_side_%d"%i,box((.018,.64,.17),center=(x,-.30,.73),color=(.14,.15,.13)))
    add(counter,"sink_rim_side_%d"%i,box((.028,.68,.015),center=(x,-.30,.854),color=CHROME))
for i,y in enumerate((-.62,.02)):
    add(counter,"sink_end_%d"%i,box((.78,.018,.17),center=(-.83,y,.73),color=(.13,.14,.12)))
    add(counter,"sink_rim_end_%d"%i,box((.81,.025,.014),center=(-.83,y,.854),color=CHROME))
add(counter,"tap_foot",rod(.049,length=.028,center=(-.85,.105,.862),color=CHROME))
add(counter,"tap_stem",rod(.016,start=(-.85,.105,.87),end=(-.85,.105,1.16),color=CHROME))
add(counter,"tap_spout",sweep_tube(points=[(-.85,.105,1.16),(-.85,.10,1.20),(-.85,.055,1.22),(-.85,-.035,1.20),(-.85,-.075,1.16)],radius=.014,color=CHROME))
for i,x in enumerate((-1.02,-.68)):
    add(counter,"tap_control_%d"%i,rod(.028,length=.025,center=(x,.10,.871),color=CHROME))
    add(counter,"tap_lever_%d"%i,rod(.011,start=(x,.1,.89),end=(x+.035,.10,.94),color=CHROME))
scene.include("counter",counter)

appliances=Asset("Countertop appliances")
add(appliances,"blender_base",rod(.105,length=.205,center=(-.04,.27,.955),color=(.026,.029,.023)))
add(appliances,"blender_collar",rod(.095,length=.04,center=(-.04,.27,1.07),color=(.08,.08,.065)))
cup=rod(.063,length=.29,center=(-.055,.27,1.22),color=(.49,.47,.37),opacity=.29)
cup.turn('y',-13)
add(appliances,"blender_cup",cup)
add(appliances,"cup_bottom",rod(.061,length=.022,center=(-.023,.27,1.084),color=(.12,.12,.095)))
add(appliances,"cup_lip",rod(.067,length=.012,center=(-.087,.27,1.367),color=(.52,.51,.43)))
# Water-filter pitcher: blue reservoir, pale slanted lid, and open handle.
body=ball(.20,center=(.56,.30,1.055),color=NAVY,opacity=.85)
body.resize((.80,.70,1.31))
add(appliances,"pitcher_body",body)
add(appliances,"pitcher_base",rod(.125,length=.025,center=(.56,.30,.849),color=(.08,.09,.10)))
lid=rod(.155,length=.028,center=(.56,.29,1.285),color=(.37,.38,.33))
lid.resize((1,.77,1))
lid.turn('y',-12)
add(appliances,"pitcher_lid",lid)
add(appliances,"pitcher_handle",sweep_tube(points=[(.68,.29,1.25),(.79,.29,1.20),(.82,.29,1.08),(.79,.29,.96),(.70,.29,.94)],radius=.027,color=(.36,.38,.34)))
scene.include("appliances",appliances)

jug=Asset("Translucent water jug")
body=ball(.155,center=(.245,-.12,1.005),color=(.70,.73,.66),opacity=.87)
body.resize((.93,.76,1.14))
add(jug,"rounded_body",body)
add(jug,"flat_lower_body",rod(.136,length=.17,center=(.245,-.12,.948),color=(.70,.73,.66),opacity=.88))
shoulder=ball(.113,center=(.245,-.12,1.14),color=(.73,.75,.67),opacity=.88)
shoulder.resize((1,.88,.66))
add(jug,"shoulder",shoulder)
add(jug,"neck",rod(.041,length=.061,center=(.245,-.12,1.209),color=(.78,.79,.70)))
add(jug,"cap",rod(.043,length=.029,center=(.245,-.12,1.242),color=(.85,.84,.73)))
add(jug,"handle",sweep_tube(points=[(.335,-.12,1.15),(.385,-.12,1.10),(.38,-.12,1.015),(.34,-.12,.99)],radius=.018,color=(.76,.78,.69)))
# Sparse gray label strokes on the front face.
for i in range(6):
    add(jug,"label_stroke_%d"%i,box((.002,.002,.021+.006*(i%2)),center=(.196+i*.016,-.241,.94),color=(.32,.34,.32)))
scene.include("water_jug",jug)

small=Asset("Small counter objects")
add(small,"green_canister",rod(.057,length=.19,center=(-.31,.26,.95),color=(.30,.33,.16)))
add(small,"canister_lid",rod(.060,length=.019,center=(-.31,.26,1.054),color=(.47,.45,.27)))
add(small,"small_tin",rod(.042,length=.046,center=(-.51,.035,.87),color=(.23,.22,.16)))
add(small,"tin_top",rod(.035,length=.005,center=(-.51,.035,.896),color=(.42,.39,.29)))
add(small,"soap_dish",box((.18,.12,.018),center=(-1.22,-.015,.866),color=(.37,.35,.26)))
add(small,"soap",box((.115,.075,.027),center=(-1.22,-.015,.888),color=(.81,.77,.58)))
scene.include("small_objects",small)

realize(scene)

# Procedural stone speckles and subtle paper grain.
for mat in bpy.data.materials:
    c=mat.diffuse_color
    if sum(abs(c[i]-GRANITE[i]) for i in range(3)) < .065:
        mat.use_nodes=True
        nt=mat.node_tree
        bs=nt.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
        noise=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value=185
        noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value=2
        ramp=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.25
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(.065,.058,.043,1)
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.77
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(.58,.53,.41,1)
        nt.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs[0])
        nt.links.new(ramp.outputs[0],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.57
    elif sum(abs(c[i]-CHROME[i]) for i in range(3)) < .03:
        mat.use_nodes=True
        bs=mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
        bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=.8
        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.25

CAMERA_POSITION=(-1.10,-2.25,1.80)
CAMERA_TARGET=(-.035,.28,1.52)
CAMERA_LENS=57
set_view(CAMERA_POSITION,CAMERA_TARGET,lens=CAMERA_LENS,sensor=36)
sc=bpy.context.scene
if sc.world is None:
    sc.world=bpy.data.worlds.new("Ambient")
sc.world.use_nodes=True
sc.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value=(.68,.73,.78,1)
sc.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=.38
area_emitter((-1.7,-.10,2.15),power=210,size=1.65,target=(.15,.25,1.3),color=(.84,.92,1))
area_emitter((-.3,-1.5,2.7),power=90,size=2.0,target=(.2,.2,1.3),color=(1,.84,.64))
sc.view_settings.view_transform='Standard'
sc.view_settings.exposure=0
sc.view_settings.gamma=1
```
